platform: Arch Linux x86_64, Hyprland 0.56.2, one 2560x1600 monitor at scale 2
commands: qs ipc call io.github.frestina.machines open / close / refresh
omarchy plugin update io.github.frestina.machines --yes && omarchy restart shell
results: Installed from git and enabled into the bar without errors.
Popup listed four real machines, one local and three over ssh, with the optional agent and dotfiles checks configured.
Right-click table ran the bundled script from the plugin folder.
Update pulled the new commit; new QML loaded after omarchy restart shell.
Missing hosts file, unknown config key and unreachable host give explicit errors (unit and end-to-end tests).
preview.png captured from the installed widget showing only demo/fixtures data; the real cache was restored.
limitations: Tested on x86_64 with a horizontal bar on one monitor; vertical bars and several monitors were not re-tested for this release.
omarchy plugin remove not yet run against this release.
